name: Panicci Ventures
introHtml: Thanks for doing this — it means a lot. A few quick questions about our work together. Just talk naturally, 30–60 seconds each. No script to memorize.

questions.label: Intro
questions.text: Introduce yourself — your name, your business, and what you do.

questions.label: Before
questions.text: Before Panicci Ventures, what did your online presence look like — and what was that costing you?

questions.label: Why Sammy
questions.text: Why did you choose Sammy and Panicci Ventures to reach your online visibility goals?

questions.label: What We Handle
questions.text: What does Panicci Ventures actually handle for you day to day — website, search, Google Business Profile, reviews, content?

questions.label: Growth
questions.text: How has your business grown since we started — rankings, calls, bookings, walk-ins, revenue? Share the win you're proudest of.

questions.label: What's Working
questions.text: What's working best right now — and which result honestly surprised you the most?

questions.label: Working with Sammy
questions.text: How is working with Sammy different from other agencies or marketers — communication, speed, month-to-month with no lock-in?

questions.label: Moment
questions.text: Is there a specific moment that made you think “okay, this is actually working”?

questions.label: Recommend
questions.text: What would you tell another business owner who's great at what they do but invisible online?

questions.label: One-liner
questions.text: Finish this sentence: “Working with Sammy P is…”

editingBrief: PARTNER TESTIMONIAL for Panicci Ventures (generic — any client without a personalized page yet). Goal: case-study proof for panicciventures.com and pitch decks. Produce a full-length cut plus one clip per segment. GROWTH, MOMENT, and SAMMY are the hero clips; RECO and ONE are the ad closers. Trim dead air, burn in captions, keep the speaker centered, export per platformTargets.
